setup_logger_stdout: setup a logger that writes DEBUG messages to stdout with timestamps and log levels
setup_logger_file: setup a logger that writes DEBUG messages to a file in a specified save directory
setup_logger_distributed: setup a logger that skips handler setup for non-master distributed processes with rank greater than zero
setup_logger_custom_filename: setup a logger that writes to a custom filename instead of the default log.txt
review_setup_logger: review the setup_logger function to understand how it configures stdout and file handlers for logging
